title: Favourite tools
intro: The things you use every day shape how a day feels. A few open questions about them. No right answers.

prompts.text: Which tool do you reach for without thinking, and why do you like it?
What is one small thing about your setup that makes the day nicer?
Is there a shortcut or trick you are glad you learned?
What is a tool you have not tried yet but are curious about?
Which tool would you miss most if it vanished tomorrow?
What is one thing you could tweak this week to make your workspace more comfortable?
What is a habit around your tools that works well for you?
Think of something you made well recently. What helped you make it?
